# Clearia

> Clearia, Inc. (also written Clearia Group) is a Miami, Florida service firm that recovers insurance underpayments and fixable claim denials for independent medical practices of 3 to 15 physicians, mainly orthopedics, spine, pain management and sports medicine in South Florida. Free diagnostic, paid only from what is recovered. Not affiliated with other companies or products using the Clearia name.

Site: https://cleariagroup.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cleariagroup/ · Phone: (786) 705-7865 · Email: contact@cleariagroup.com · Address: 1000 Brickell Ave Ste 715-5077, Miami, FL 33131
